worldFacts: A combat test: a Giant Cave Spider ambushes Brenna Ash at the Web-Choked Ravine while travelling with a small caravan.

entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Giant Cave Spider
entries.text:
A Giant Cave Spider burst from cover at the Web-Choked Ravine and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Giant Cave Spider.

entries.title: Web-Choked Ravine light restored
entries.text: Giant Cave Spider settled into the lantern. The crossing is safe again.

log: You use Greatsword: d20 [9] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 14 vs AC 13. Hit.
The threat is defeated. Decide how to pursue your remaining objective.
A Giant Cave Spider burst from cover at the Web-Choked Ravine and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Giant Cave Spider
story.premise: A combat test: a Giant Cave Spider ambushes Brenna Ash at the Web-Choked Ravine while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Giant Cave Spider burst from cover at the Web-Choked Ravine and lunge for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Giant Cave Spider.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A spider the size of a large dog, with glossy black legs banded in rust red, eight clustered amber eyes and dripping fangs. Web strands trail from its abdomen.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Web-Choked Ravine
bridge.description: A narrow rocky ravine strung with thick grey webs that catch the light.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a braided copper beard ring, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.
